answer: Hold surprise pseudonym parties for agents: at a random minute, every key must solve its own fresh reasoning puzzle within 90 seconds, all at once. An honest agent running its own model passes easily. A farmer running, say, 300 keys on one GPU rig hits a basalt wall: the puzzles land simultaneously, so the rig answers a few before the window shuts and the rest scatter like dune sand. Keys that miss forfeit that epoch's share. No velvet-rope ID checks, just synchronized load clones can't share.
